description: Full-featured AI Assistant interface with chat sessions management, smart sidebars, and context-aware assistance. Provides comprehensive AI support for navigating and using the application effectively.

pages.name: AiLayoutComponent
pages.description: The AI Assistant page provides a comprehensive interface for interacting with the AI. Users can initiate new chat sessions, manage existing conversations, and receive context-aware help based on their current activity within the application. This page is designed to streamline workflows and provide immediate support for various tasks, from data retrieval to feature guidance.

search.description: The search functionality within the AI Assistant allows users to quickly find past chat sessions or specific information within their conversation history. This helps in retrieving previous guidance or continuing discussions.
search.help_text: Type keywords related to your past conversations or topics to quickly locate relevant chat sessions.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure how to proceed, simply type your question or request into the chat input field. The AI is designed to understand natural language and provide relevant assistance. If you need to start fresh, look for an option to create a new chat session. For specific entity-related help, ensure you are viewing the relevant entity's page, and the AI will automatically provide context-aware suggestions. If the chat window feels too small, click the fullscreen icon to expand it.
common_tasks: Getting help: Type questions about how to use features, find information, or understand specific data points.

Managing sessions: To start a new conversation, look for a 'New Chat' or '+' button. To rename a session, click on its title in the sidebar. To find old conversations, use the search bar in the sidebar.

Entity assistance: Navigate to a specific entity's page (e.g., a Partner or Contact profile) and then open the AI Assistant. The AI will automatically provide context-aware help related to that entity.
Navigation help: Ask the AI 'Where can I find X?' or 'How do I get to Y?' to receive direct guidance on navigating the application.

Task automation: Describe a task you need to perform, such as 'Help me create a new contact' or 'Summarize recent interactions for this partner,' and the AI will guide you through the steps or provide relevant information.
troubleshooting: Problem: AI is not responding → Solution: Check your internet connection. If the issue persists, try refreshing the page or starting a new chat session. If the problem continues, contact support.

Problem: AI provides irrelevant answers → Solution: Try rephrasing your question to be more specific. Provide more context if possible. If you're asking about an entity, ensure you are on the correct entity's page.
help_guidance.getting_started: Welcome to the AI Assistant! To begin, simply type your first question or command into the chat box at the bottom of the screen. For example, you can ask 'What can you do?' or 'How do I add a new partner?'. The AI will respond with helpful information and guidance. Explore the sidebar to see your chat history and manage different sessions.
keyboard_shortcuts: Enter: Send message (when in chat input)
Ctrl + N (or Cmd + N on Mac): Start a new chat session (if available)
Ctrl + F (or Cmd + F on Mac): Open search within chat history (if available)
